paragraphs: Mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah 54:5; perhaps it should read “bar Chakula.”[^1]

notes.text: Hyman’s “perhaps” presents bar Chakula as a conjectural correction of bar Chakuri, not an independently attested variant. נד־ה gives the supplied Bereshit Rabbah 54:5 locator without independent named-edition verification. The abbreviated heading title remains R'.
